dealSummary: Former English soccer star David Beckham’s health drink startup IM8 has raised $1 billion in funding from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

AdvanCell, a clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company developing targeted alpha therapies for cancer based in Boston and Brisbane, received a $315 million Series D led by Ally Bridge Group and Alpha Wave.

Massachusetts-based Walden Robotics, which manufactures general-purpose robots for manufacturing and logistics, raised a $300 million seed round at a $1.1 billion valuation, led by Toyota and Deviation Capital with additional backing from Nvidia, Menlo Ventures and Samsung Ventures.
leadInvestors: Toyota, Deviation Capital with additional backing from Nvidia, Menlo Ventures, Samsung Ventures

dealSummary: San Francisco-based Emergent, whose AI platform lets non-technical founders build full-stack applications, raised a $130 million Series C at a $1.5 billion valuation, led by Creaegis with additional backing from Khosla, SoftBank’s Vision Fund 2, Lightspeed and Y Combinator.
leadInvestors: Creaegis with additional backing from Khosla, SoftBank’s Vision Fund 2, Lightspeed, Y Combinator

dealSummary: California-based Lumin Digital, a digital banking software company, raised $115 million at a $1.6 billion valuation from investors including Light Street Capital.
San Jose-based Spectro Cloud, a provider of AI infrastructure management software, raised more than $100 million in a Series D led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives.
leadInvestors: Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives

dealSummary: California-based Senra Systems, which uses software to modernize wire harness manufacturing for aerospace and defense, raised a $65 million Series B led by Lowercarbon Capital and Interlagos.
